challenge.method: Compare the rendered test, the original numbered GO TO, the two formulas and the list of six relations. Check the separately documented QuickBASIC block form for contrary scope.
challenge.results: The historical manual supports conditional selection of a numbered instruction when the relation holds. Its no-branch path continues normally and no block terminator is part of this form.

limitations: The exact scope is the May 1964 numbered IF form and its test, without a later block-syntax or arithmetic claim.
